utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many more helpers do you still need, and what jobs should I pass along?

utterances.text: Rosa: I could use about 3 more helpers, mostly for sorting donations and greeting people at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting out the helper list for Saturday on the front porch, so if you know anyone handy, please send them my way.

utterances.text: Vik: I’m still organizing the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch, and I could use a few more helpers. I’ll send anyone handy your way.

utterances.text: Tess: That’s right, I’m still lining up a few handy folks for Saturday on the front porch. If you hear of anyone who can lend a hand, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, it’s this Saturday on the front porch, and I could still use a few more helpers if you know anyone free.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I come by on Saturday, and what kind of help do you need?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still pinning down the timing, but if you can come by the front porch Saturday and help with the practical stuff, that would really help. I’ll send the final details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’m still trying to round up a few helpers for Saturday on the front porch. If anyone handy is free, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That would help a lot, Oren. Come by around 10 on Saturday at the front porch, and I’ll put you to work.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m putting together the repair drive on the front porch this Saturday, and I could use a few helpers. Can you lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can help this Saturday on the front porch. Just tell me what time you want me there.
